name: BBQ Sauce

low.description: No safe serving - contains high FODMAP ingredients

siboNotes: Most commercial BBQ sauces contain high FODMAP ingredients like high fructose corn syrup, onion, and garlic powder. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Make homemade BBQ sauce using garlic oil instead of garlic powder
Use maple syrup or brown sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup
Add green tops of scallions for onion flavor instead of onion powder
Check ingredient labels carefully as formulations vary between brands
alternatives: Homemade low-FODMAP BBQ sauce with safe ingredients
Tomato paste mixed with maple syrup and spices
Low-FODMAP ketchup with added smoked paprika
Simple olive oil and herb marinades
nutritionalHighlights: May contain lycopene from tomato base
